NOTES TO UNAUDITED STANDALONE FINANCIAL RESULTS:

1. The Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and have been approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held today. The Statutory auditors of the company have issued limited review report with unmodified opinion on the above results.

2. The above financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 and the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules, 2016.

3. The Company is primarily engaged in the business of promotion and development of real estate activities, which as per IND AS - 108 “Operating Segments” is considered to be the only reportable segment.

4. The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on December 05, 2025 had approved the Scheme of Arrangement between Gatil Properties Private Limited (“Transferor Company”) and Ganesh Housing Limited (“Transferee Company”) and their respective shareholders under Sections 230 to 232 read with Section 52 and 66 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 subject to the approval of Shareholders and other statutory/ regulatory authorities. The Company received the no-objection letter dated July 06, 2026 from National Stock Exchange of India Limited and the no adverse observations letter dated July 06, 2026 from BSE Limited. In this regard an application was filed with the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench (‘NCLT’). Pursuant to the order dated October 07, 2026 read with corrigendum order dated October 09, 2026 passed by the NCLT, a meeting of the Equity Shareholders (which also includes public shareholders), of the Company, will be convened on Friday, November 27, 2026 for the purpose of considering, and if thought fit, to pass the arrangement embodied in the Scheme of Arrangement. Accordingly, no impact is given on account of this in the Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

5. Previous period figures have been regrouped and reclassified, where necessary, to make them comparable with current quarter figures
